claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.triggered_on_event
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable fires reactively when a specific game event occurs (failing a saving throw). ClassFeatureActivationCost only has 'free' and 'bonus_action'. Neither expresses event-triggered activation. Using 'free' would drop the trigger constraint and misrepresent the mechanic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect.modify_roll_reroll_with_bonus
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable's core effect is to reroll a failed saving throw and add a class-level-scaled flat bonus to the result. The v4 atoms 'modify_roll_reroll' and 'modify_roll_numeric' both exist in the taxonomy but ClassFeatureEffect only contains GrantExtraActionEffect and HealHpEffect. A new variant expressing (reroll + numeric modifier on a named roll) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll
